title: Implementing security and responsible AI - AWS Prescriptive Guidance
quotation: A model card should include detailed specifications of the model architecture, training methodology, and hyperparameter configurations, along with performance metrics across diverse datasets and demographic groups. It must also explicitly outline both intended use cases and scenarios where the model should not be applied, establishing clear boundaries for appropriate deployment.
